definitions.explanation: The act of providing money as capital for a business venture or company, typically in exchange for ownership or profit share.

examples.japanese: {新事業|しんじぎょう}に{出資|しゅっし}する。
examples.english: To invest in a new business.

examples.japanese: {出資|しゅっし}{者|しゃ}を{募集|ぼしゅう}している。
{出資|しゅっし}{比率|ひりつ}に{応|おう}じて{利益|りえき}を{分配|ぶんぱい}する。
examples.english: Profits are distributed according to the investment ratio.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{出資|しゅっし}{者|しゃ} - investor, contributor
・{出資|しゅっし}{金|きん} - investment capital
・{出資|しゅっし}{比率|ひりつ} - investment ratio
・{共同|きょうどう}{出資|しゅっし} - joint investment
・{出資|しゅっし}を{募|つの}る - to seek investment

BUSINESS CONTEXT:
Used in business/corporate contexts to describe contributing capital to a company.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{投資|とうし} - investment (more general, includes stocks)
・{融資|ゆうし} - financing, loan (lending money)
